name: minimax-agent-reply-latency
title: MiniMax Agent Reply Latency & Context Bloat Investigation
description: Investigate why @minimax-test replies take 15-25s and why cacheReadInputTokens reaches ~95k. Capture root cause and candidate fixes so the team can decide on the optimization approach.
creator: 张岩.ean
notes: Initial diagnosis (large cache due to MiniMax prompt size/session reuse) was partially wrong. Another agent found that MiniMax's Anthropic-compat adapter inflates reported cache_read tokens by ~3x in usage and ~8x in modelUsage vs. session ground truth. The real fix adds a runtime warmup gate and flags providerReportedInflated in latency traces.
